sections.h2: What Is a Progressive Web App?

paragraphs.text: What is a progressive web app? It is a website built with modern web features that let it behave like an installed app. Users open it from a link, tap "Add to Home Screen" or "Install", and from then on it launches from an icon, opens full-screen and loads instantly.

Two technologies make this possible. A web app manifest tells the phone the app's name, icon and colours. A service worker is a small script that saves key files and data on the device, so the app opens quickly and keeps working offline. As a PWA development company, our job is to plan which screens and data must work offline, then build that reliably.

sections.h2: What PWA Services Does Teknoppy Offer?
sections.intro: Our progressive web app development services cover new builds, conversions of existing websites and ongoing support.

items.title: Installable Web App Development
items.text: An installable web app gives customers or staff an app icon, full-screen view and fast loading, without downloading anything from an app store. Updates reach every user the next time they open it, with no store approval needed.

items.title: Offline Web App Development
items.text: Offline web app development lets users keep working when the signal drops. Forms, checklists, orders and notes are saved on the device and sent automatically when the connection returns. This is essential for teams working in warehouses, rural areas, construction sites or on the road.

items.title: Service Worker Development
items.text: Service worker development decides what the app stores, for how long and how it updates. Good caching rules make the app fast without showing outdated prices or stock. Poor ones cause the stale-content problems many PWAs suffer from, so we test this layer carefully.

items.title: PWA Push Notifications
items.text: PWA push notifications remind users about orders, appointments, offers or tasks, directly on their phone or desktop. Users choose whether to allow them, and we keep messages useful.

items.title: Convert Website to PWA
items.html: If you already have a good website, we can convert the website to a PWA without a full rebuild. We add the manifest, service worker, offline pages and install prompts, and fix any speed or layout issues that would hurt the app experience.

paragraphs.text: Typical projects from our PWA development company include ordering apps for distributors and their retailers, job and inspection apps for service technicians, booking and loyalty apps for restaurants and salons, and learning apps for training institutes whose students rely on mobile data.

sections.h2: PWAs for Ecommerce, Field Teams and Low-Data Users

paragraphs.text: A PWA for ecommerce helps shoppers return to your store from a home-screen icon, browse quickly on slow networks and receive back-in-stock or order updates. Many shoppers skip store apps but will add a PWA in one tap.

A PWA for field teams gives sales staff, technicians and inspectors one tool for orders, job sheets, photos and signatures, even without network coverage. Data syncs automatically once they are back online.
A low data mode web app compresses images, loads only essential content and works on older phones, which matters for customers in areas with expensive or patchy mobile data.

Can a PWA work offline? Yes. Pages, images and data saved by the service worker remain available without a connection. Users can browse saved content, fill forms and queue actions, which are sent when the connection returns. We decide during planning exactly which parts must work offline and which need a live connection, such as payments.

sections.h2: Does a PWA Work on iPhone?

paragraphs.text: Does a PWA work on iPhone? Yes. iPhone and iPad users can add a PWA to the home screen from Safari, and Apple added web push notifications for home-screen web apps in iOS 16.4. Some device features still work more fully on Android, so we check every feature you need on both platforms before the build begins.

PWA vs native app comes down to budget, reach and device features. A PWA is one codebase for all devices, needs no app store approval, updates instantly and is usually far cheaper to build and maintain. A native app has deeper access to device hardware, background tasks and app store visibility.

paragraphs.html: If you need heavy device features, see our Flutter, Android and iOS app pages. If you mainly need fast access, offline use and notifications, a PWA usually delivers most of the value at a fraction of the cost.

paragraphs.text: Trusted Web Activity Play Store listing: a PWA can also be published on Google Play using Trusted Web Activity, so users who search the store can still find and install it.

sections.h2: How Much Does a PWA Cost in India?

paragraphs.text: How much does a PWA cost in India? It depends on the number of screens, offline requirements, integrations and notifications. A website conversion costs far less than a new field app with offline sync. A PWA is usually much cheaper than building separate Android and iOS apps.
Every project is quoted after discovery. Each quote from our PWA development company is fixed for the agreed scope and lists exactly what is included.

items.q: How long does a PWA take to build?
items.a: Converting an existing website usually takes 3 to 4 weeks. A new customer-facing PWA takes 6 to 8 weeks, and a field app with offline sync takes 10 to 12 weeks. We confirm the timeline in writing after discovery.

items.q: Is a PWA good for SEO?
items.a: Yes. A PWA is still a website, so its pages can be indexed by Google when they render content properly. PWAs also tend to load faster, which supports better search performance and user experience.

items.q: How do I choose a PWA development company?
items.a: Ask to install and test apps the team has already built, check how they handle offline data and updates, and confirm that developers are in-house. A reliable PWA development company gives a fixed written scope and tests on both Android and iPhone.
